iso_metric_holes.csv.title: ISO metric holes: coarse pitch, tap drill, clearance, counterbore and countersink
iso_metric_holes.csv.basis: Coarse pitch per ISO 261; tap drill about d - P per ISO 2306; clearance fine/medium/coarse per ISO 273; counterbore for ISO 4762 heads per DIN 974-1 (head dk max plus clearance, depth = k plus 0.4-0.6 mm); 90 deg countersink at the theoretical ISO 10642 head diameter (no M18 in ISO 10642).
iso_metric_holes.csv.source: Values encoded from the standards' published dimension tables; cross-checked against bd_warehouse's clearance_hole_sizes.csv and tap_hole_sizes.csv.
iso_metric_holes.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard documents themselves are not reproduced.

iso4762_length_range.csv.title: ISO 4762 socket head cap screw nominal length range, M3-M12
iso4762_length_range.csv.basis: Shortest and longest commercial nominal length per size, as tabled by bd_warehouse.

deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.title: Single-row deep-groove ball bearings 608, 60xx and 62xx: boundary dimensions, mass, dynamic load rating
deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.basis: Boundary dimensions d x D x B and minimum corner chamfer r_s per ISO 15; basic dynamic load rating C (for ISO 281 L10 life) and mass from the manufacturer's catalogue, rounded.
deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.source: SKF general catalogue values (rounded); 608, 6000 and 6200 cross-checked against bd_warehouse's bearing table.
deep_groove_ball_bearings.csv.licence: Dimensions and ratings are published facts; no catalogue text or drawings reproduced.

belt_profiles.csv.title: Synchronous belt profiles GT2, HTD 3M and HTD 5M: pitch, pitch-line differential, groove and belt sizes
belt_profiles.csv.basis: Pitch and pitch-line differential (pulley OD = teeth x pitch / pi - 2 x PLD) as published for each profile; the groove is simplified to a round groove of the published tooth height, which is enough for envelopes and clearances, not for tooth contact.
belt_profiles.csv.source: Belt manufacturers' published profile data (Gates, Optibelt), rounded. Approximate: verify against the supplier's pulley drawing before machining a pulley.
belt_profiles.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; no catalogue drawings reproduced.

linear_guides.csv.title: Miniature (MGN) and standard (HGR) profile rail guides: rail, block and mounting dimensions
linear_guides.csv.basis: Rail width and height, mounting-hole pitch, block width, assembly height, block length (C standard, H long) and block mounting pattern, as typical of HIWIN MGN / HG and compatible guides.
linear_guides.csv.source: Manufacturers' published catalogue dimensions, from memory of the common values. Approximate: guides are not dimensionally standardised across makers, so verify every value against the chosen supplier's catalogue before designing around it.
linear_guides.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; no catalogue drawings reproduced.

sfu_ball_screws.csv.title: SFU rolled ball screws and flanged single nuts (12-25 mm)
sfu_ball_screws.csv.basis: Screw diameter and lead, ball size, nut body diameter, round flange diameter and thickness, nut length and flange bolt circle, as typical of SFU-series nuts (flange flats not modelled).
sfu_ball_screws.csv.source: Typical supplier datasheet values for SFU nuts. Approximate: SFU nuts vary between makers; verify against the supplier's drawing.
sfu_ball_screws.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; no catalogue drawings reproduced.

linear_bushings.csv.title: Linear ball bushings LMxxUU (standard and long) and LMFxxUU (round flange)
linear_bushings.csv.basis: Shaft diameter d, outside diameter D, length L; for flanged types the flange diameter, thickness, bolt circle and hole size. Retaining-ring grooves are not modelled.
linear_bushings.csv.source: Common catalogue values for the LM series (Misumi, THK-compatible). The plain LM sizes are well established; flange dimensions are approximate, verify against the supplier.
linear_bushings.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; no catalogue drawings reproduced.

ucp_pillow_blocks.csv.title: UCP 201-208 pillow block units (cast housing with a set-screw insert bearing)
ucp_pillow_blocks.csv.basis: Bore d, shaft centre height H, length L, bolt spacing J, base width A, bolt hole, base thickness, overall height and insert width per the ISO 3228 P2xx housing series.
ucp_pillow_blocks.csv.source: Common catalogue values for UCP2xx units (NSK, FYH, SKF SY-compatible), rounded. Approximate: verify against the supplier.
ucp_pillow_blocks.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; no catalogue drawings reproduced.

din705_collars.csv.title: Set collars DIN 705 form A (with set screw)
din705_collars.csv.basis: Bore d, outside diameter D, width b and set screw size.
din705_collars.csv.source: DIN 705 form A dimension table as published by fastener suppliers, rounded. Approximate for the smallest sizes.
din705_collars.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard document is not reproduced.

en10365_beams.csv.title: Hot-rolled I and H sections IPE, HEA and HEB
en10365_beams.csv.basis: Height h, flange width b, web thickness tw, flange thickness tf and root radius r per the European section tables.
en10365_beams.csv.source: EN 10365 dimension tables as published by steel suppliers (ArcelorMittal and others). Area and second moments in the parts are computed from this geometry and checked against the published values in the tests.
en10365_beams.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard document is not reproduced.

en10365_channels.csv.title: Hot-rolled channels UPN (taper flange)
en10365_channels.csv.basis: Height h, flange width b, web thickness tw, flange thickness tf half-way along the flange and root radius r; the flange inner face is drawn with its 8 % taper, toe radii are not modelled.
en10365_channels.csv.source: EN 10365 / DIN 1026-1 channel tables as published by steel suppliers.
en10365_channels.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard documents are not reproduced.

en10056_angles.csv.title: Hot-rolled equal-leg angles
en10056_angles.csv.basis: Leg length a, thickness t and root radius r1 (toe radii not modelled).
en10056_angles.csv.source: EN 10056-1 angle tables as published by steel suppliers; root radii rounded and approximate for the smallest sizes.
en10056_angles.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard document is not reproduced.

en10219_hollow.csv.title: Cold-formed structural hollow sections SHS, RHS and CHS
en10219_hollow.csv.basis: Outside dimensions h x b (CHS: outside diameter) and wall t; square and rectangular corners use the EN 10219-2 outer radius 2t (t <= 6), 2.5t (t <= 10), else 3t. A common size range, not every listed size.
en10219_hollow.csv.source: EN 10219-2 size tables as published by steel suppliers.
en10219_hollow.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard document is not reproduced.

iso8734_dowels.csv.title: Parallel dowel pins ISO 8734 (hardened) and ISO 2338 (unhardened): diameters and length ranges
iso8734_dowels.csv.basis: Nominal diameter (tolerance m6) and the commercial length range per diameter; lengths take the preferred series 3-100 mm within that range.
iso8734_dowels.csv.source: Length ranges as listed by fastener suppliers for ISO 8734 / ISO 2338 pins (approximate at the range ends).
iso8734_dowels.csv.licence: Dimensions are facts; the standard documents are not reproduced.
